text: EX-99.1 2 aptvq32026ex991.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 aptvq32026ex991 Aptiv Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Record third quarter revenues reflect strong growth in non-automotive SCHAFFHAUSEN - Aptiv PLC (NYSE: APTV), a global industrial technology company, today reported financial results for the third quarter of 2026. Third Quarter Financial Highlights Include: • U.S. GAAP revenue of $3.2 billion, an increase of 2% ◦ Adjusted revenue growth of 2% • U.S. GAAP net income from continuing operations of $194 million • Adjusted EBITDA of $567 million • U.S. GAAP diluted earnings per share from continuing operations of $0.94 ◦ Adjusted net income per share of $1.42 Year-to-Date Financial Highlights Include: • U.S. GAAP revenue of $9.5 billion, an increase of 2% ◦ Adjusted revenue growth of 1% • U.S. GAAP net income from continuing operations of $621 million • Adjusted EBITDA of $1,729 million • U.S. GAAP diluted earnings per share from continuing operations of $2.95 ◦ Adjusted net income per share of $4.26 “During the third quarter, we delivered solid financial results and continued to execute against our strategic priorities,” said Kevin Clark, chair and chief executive officer. “Our differentiated portfolio, backed by a resilient supply chain, continues to deliver performance and cost benefits for customers in a changing macro environment. Strong non-automotive revenue and bookings growth reflects the applicability of our products and capabilities across new and existing end markets. Through operational execution and disciplined capital allocation, we remain focused on investing in long-term growth and delivering on our commitment to prioritize returning capital to shareholders.” Third Quarter 2026 Results For the three months ended September 30, 2026, the Company reported U.S. GAAP revenue of $3.2 billion, an increase of 2% from the prior year period. Adjusted for currency exchange, commodity movements and the EDS spin-off in prior periods, revenue increased by 2% in the third quarter. This reflects growth of 5% in North America, Exhibit 99.1 5% in Asia Pacific, which includes growth of 1% in China, and 3% in South America, our smallest region, partially offset by declines of 5% in EMEA. The Company reported third quarter 2026 U.S. GAAP net income from continuing operations of $194 million, net income margin from continuing operations of 6.1% and earnings from continuing operations of $0.94 per diluted share, compared to U.S. GAAP net loss from continuing operations of $488 million, net loss margin from continuing operations of 15.6% and loss from continuing operations of $2.24 per diluted share, which includes the impacts of a non-cash goodwill impairment charge of $648 million in the prior year period. Third quarter Adjusted Net Income totaled $292 million, or earnings of $1.42 per diluted share, compared to $321 million, or $1.48 per diluted share, in the prior year period. Adjusted amounts in periods prior to the EDS spin-off are presented on a pro forma basis for the impacts of the spin-off. The Company reported third quarter Adjusted EBITDA of $567 million, compared to $598 million in the prior year period. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 17.7%, compared to 19.1% in the prior year period. Depreciation and amortization expense totaled $247 million, which includes non-cash intangible asset impairment charges of $56 million, compared to $193 million in the prior year period. Interest expense for the third quarter totaled $59 million, compared to $88 million in the prior year period. Tax expense in the third quarter of 2026 was $36 million, compared to $59 million in the prior year period. Net cash flow provided by operating activities from continuing operations totaled $320 million in the third quarter, with Free Cash Flow of $194 million. Year-to-Date 2026 Results For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company reported U.S. GAAP revenue of $9.5 billion, an increase of 2% from the prior year period. Adjusted for currency exchange and commodity movements and the EDS spin-off in prior periods, revenue increased by 1% during the period. This reflects growth of 8% in North America and 2% in Asia Pacific, which includes a decline of 2% in China, partially offset by declines of 6% in EMEA and 1% in South America, our smallest region. The Company reported 2026 year-to-date U.S. GAAP net income from continuing operations of $621 million, net income margin from continuing operations of 6.5% and earnings from continuing operations of $2.95 per diluted share, compared to U.S. GAAP net loss from continuing operations of $363 million, net loss margin from continuing operations of 3.9% and loss from continuing operations of $1.64 per diluted share, which includes the impacts of a non-cash goodwill impairment charge of $648 million in the prior year period. Year-to-date Adjusted Net Income totaled $897 million, or earnings of $4.26 per diluted share, compared to $940 million, or $4.24 per diluted share, in the prior year period. Adjusted amounts in periods prior to the EDS spin-off are presented on a pro forma basis for the impacts of the spin-off. For the 2026 year-to-date period, The Company reported Adjusted EBITDA of $1,729 million, compared to $1,754 million in the prior year period. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 18.1%, compared to 18.8% in the prior year period. Depreciation and amortization expense totaled $631 million, which includes non-cash intangible asset impairment charges of $56 million, compared to $572 million in the prior year period. Interest expense for the year- to-date period totaled $205 million, compared to $273 million in the prior year period. 2 Tax expense in the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was $130 million. Tax expense in the nine months ended September 30, 2025 was $401 million, which primarily reflects an increase to valuation allowances of approximately $300 million on deferred tax assets impacted by the OECD Administrative Guidance issued in the first quarter of 2025. Reconciliations of Adjusted Revenue Growth, Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted Net Income, Adjusted Net Income Per Share and Free Cash Flow, which are non-GAAP measures, to the most directly comparable financial measures, respectively, calculated and presented in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States (“GAAP”) are provided in the attached supplemental schedules. Share Repurchases The Company repurchased and retired 4.7 million shares for $233 million in the third quarter of 2026, bringing the year-to-date total to $558 million. As of September 30, 2026, $1.6 billion remained available for future share repurchases under the Company’s existing authorization. A replay will be available two hours following the conference call. 3 Use of Non-GAAP Financial Information This press release contains information about Aptiv’s financial results which are not presented in accordance with GAAP. Specifically, Adjusted Revenue Growth, Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted Net Income, Adjusted Net Income Per Share and Free Cash Flow are non-GAAP financial measures. These Non-GAAP metrics are adjusted for the spin-off of the Company’s Electrical Distribution Systems (“EDS”) segment in prior periods, and represent the financial results of Aptiv’s remaining segments (“New Aptiv”), with the EDS segment not included. These Non-GAAP metrics do not include general corporate overhead expenses that were previously allocated to the EDS segment in periods prior to the spin-off, but which are included in income from continuing operations as presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP. Management has implemented plans to substantially eliminate these costs following the spin-off, and therefore believes it appropriate to provide this presentation for improved comparability between periods in order to reflect Aptiv's results without those costs. Adjusted Revenue Growth represents the year-over-year change in reported net sales relative to the comparable period, excluding the impact on net sales from currency exchange, commodity movements, acquisitions, divestitures and other transactions, adjusted for the impacts of the EDS spin-off in periods prior to the spin-off. Adjusted EBITDA represents net income (loss) before depreciation and amortization (including asset impairments), interest expense, income tax (expense) benefit, other income (expense), net, equity income (loss), net of tax, income (loss) from discontinued operations, restructuring, separation costs related to the spin-off of the EDS business, other acquisition and portfolio project costs (which includes costs incurred to integrate acquired businesses and to plan and execute product portfolio transformation actions, including business and product acquisitions and divestitures), goodwill and other asset impairments, compensation expense related to acquisitions and gains (losses) on business divestitures and other transactions, adjusted to reflect the impacts of the EDS spin- off. Adjusted EBITDA margin is defined as Adjusted EBITDA as a percentage of net sales. Adjusted Net Income represents net income (loss) attributable to Aptiv before income (loss) from discontinued operations, amortization, restructuring and other special items, adjusted to reflect the impacts of the EDS spin-off and associated debt repayments in prior periods, including the tax impact thereon. Adjusted Net Income Per Share represents Adjusted Net Income divided by the Weighted Average Number of Diluted Shares Outstanding for the period. Free Cash Flow represents cash provided by (used in) operating activities from continuing operations less capital expenditures, as adjusted to reflect the impacts of the EDS spin-off and associated debt repayments in prior periods. Management believes the non-GAAP financial measures used in this press release are useful to both management and investors in their analysis of the Company’s financial position, results of operations and liquidity. In particular, management believes Adjusted Revenue Growth, Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted Net Income, Adjusted Net Income Per Share and Free Cash Flow are useful measures in assessing the Company’s ongoing financial performance that, when reconciled to the corresponding GAAP measure, provide improved comparability between periods through the exclusion of certain items that management believes are not indicative of the Company’s core operating performance and that may obscure underlying business results and trends, including the impacts of the EDS spin-off. Management also uses these non-GAAP financial measures for internal planning and forecasting purposes. 4 Such non-GAAP financial measures are reconciled to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures in the attached supplemental schedules at the end of this press release. Non-GAAP measures should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for our reported results prepared in accordance with GAAP and, as calculated, may not be comparable to other similarly titled measures of other companies. About Aptiv Aptiv is a global industrial technology leader delivering advanced solutions people trust when it matters most across automotive, commercial vehicle, aerospace and defense, telecom and datacom, and other diversified industrial end markets. Our differentiated portfolio enables devices and systems to sense, think, act, and continuously optimize performance. Building on decades of innovation, Aptiv brings global scale and a resilient, localized value chain to customers across the globe. Learn more at aptiv.com. Adjusted Revenue Growth: Adjusted Revenue Growth is presented as a supplemental measure of the Company’s financial performance which management believes is useful to investors in assessing the Company’s ongoing financial performance that, when reconciled to the corresponding U.S. GAAP measure, provides improved comparability between periods through the exclusion of certain items that management believes are not indicative of the Company’s core operating performance and which may obscure underlying business results and trends. Our management utilizes Adjusted Revenue Growth in its financial decision making process, to evaluate performance of the Company and for internal reporting, planning and forecasting purposes. Adjusted Revenue Growth is defined as the year-over-year change in reported net sales relative to the comparable period, excluding the impact on net sales from currency exchange, commodity movements, acquisitions, divestitures and other transactions, adjusted for the EDS spin-off. The impact from currency exchange reflects the percentage change in revenue attributable to changes in foreign currency exchange rates in the current period as compared to the prior period, which is calculated by applying the prior period foreign currency exchange rates to current period net sales. The impact from commodity movements is calculated as the difference in the amount of net sales in the current period compared to the prior period that is attributable to escalation clauses in our contracts with our customers for recovery of increased commodity costs. The impact of acquisitions and divestitures, as applicable, is calculated as the percentage increase in net sales in the current period compared to the prior period for sales generated by a business acquired during or subsequent to the prior period, and the percentage decrease in net sales in the current period compared to the prior period for sales generated by a business that was divested during or subsequent to the prior period. Not all companies use identical calculations of Adjusted Revenue Growth, therefore this presentation may not be comparable to other similarly titled measures of other companies. Management utilizes Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted Net Income Per Share in its financial decision making process, to evaluate performance of the Company and for internal reporting, planning and forecasting purposes. Adjusted Net Income is defined as net income (loss) attributable to Aptiv before income (loss) from discontinued operations, amortization, restructuring and other special items, adjusted to reflect the impacts of the EDS spin-off and associated debt repayments in prior periods, including the tax impact thereon.
